title: The TiendaCrypto para WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not correctly verify the authenticity of its…
description: The TiendaCrypto para WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions through 1.2.1 improperly verify payment webhook authenticity by validating signatures against an always-empty key. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to forge webhook notifications and mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as paid on web servers that preserve request header case.
